messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 — KV cache miss rate spike on prod (region: us-east-1) affecting /v1/generate-toolcall path. 5xxs up 12x over baseline, p95 latency doubled. Paging oncall eng (Riley).
Riley: Acked. jumping in. any customer reports?
Maya: AcmeCorp reporting elevated errors in their realtime scoring, started ~12:03 UTC. They see structured tool outputs failing to parse.
Tom: Support: pushing their CI logs now — shows repeated toolcall responses with top-level arrays instead of objects, client lib errors out with 422.
Riley: is this the structured-output changes we rolled last week? Could be producing variable schemas that break continuous batching keys.
Diego: Looking at kvcache metrics — huge churn in keys/sec and TTL evictions. Prefetch hit rate crashed from 98% to 40%. suspect structured output arrays cause cache key normalization to miss.
Riley: can you paste the logs?
Diego: logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T12:04:02Z] route=/v1/generate-toolcall id=xy123 kvcache:key_norm="{\"tool\": \"parse\", \"input_len\": 128, \"schema_hash\": \"abc\"}" miss
[2026-03-15T12:04:03Z] tool_response: payload="[ {\"result\": ...}, {\"result\": ...} ]" size=4096
[2026-03-15T12:04:03Z] batching: batch_id=bn45 split_due_to_structured_output=true
```
Asha: wow split_due_to_structured_output flag is new — looks like runtime now splits batches when a tool returns an array so KV cache can't reuse prefix keys. that explains the blast.
Riley: impact: increased per-token CPU and cache misses -> higher latency and 5xxs. need hot mitigation: throttle prefetch + disable structured-output auto-split, or fallback to object-wrapping shim.
Diego: quick option: disable prefetch for toolcall routes for 10m and increase batching wait to absorb tail latency. patch ready: ```yaml
# hotfix patch
services:
  kvcache:
    prefetch: false
  batching:
    max_wait_ms: 80
    split_on_structured_output: false
```
Riley: can infra deploy that with a short rollout? will reduce cache churn, might increase latency a touch but will stop 5xxs.
Maya: priority: stabilize customer requests. AcmeCorp is on Dedicated plan — they need SLA update if this persists.
Tom: reaching out to AcmeCorp support lead with heads-up.
Riley: @Asha can you take deploy? I'll coordinate with Diego on config.
Asha: initiating patch deploy now. starting canary on prod-us-east-1/zone-a. command: `./ops/rollout --service=kvcache --patch=hotfix-structout-20260315.yml --canary 10%`
deploy-bot: Deploy started by Asha — rollout id 2026-03-15-structout-hotfix. Canary=10% target=prod-us-east-1/zone-a.
Asha: canary metrics: miss-rate dropping from 85%->30% in canary hosts, p95 latency down 40% on those nodes. no 5xxs in canary.
deploy-bot: Canary succeeded. progressing to 50%.
Diego: watching kvcache evictions — global evictions dropping, prefetch queue length reduced. logs show fewer "split_due_to_structured_output" events.
Riley: proceed full rollout.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete.
Maya: customer update sent: we applied a stabilization patch and are monitoring; will follow up with root cause analysis.
Tom: AcmeCorp confirmed their pipeline errors cleared, latency back to normal for them.
Diego: follow-up: root cause appears to be a model/tool change that started emitting top-level JSON arrays for certain function calls; runtime normalized cache keys by stringifying the model output which made array-vs-object variance produce different keys and prevented batching affinity.
Asha: long-term fixes: 1) implement stable key derivation that normalizes arrays (wrap or hash canonical form), 2) add a feature flag to avoid splitting batches on structured outputs unless explicitly needed, 3) add synthetic test in CI to exercise function/tool outputs returning arrays.
Riley: agreed. I'll own the incident postmortem and assign RCA owners. Diego/Riley to own immediate key-normalization patch; infra to add feature flag gating.
Maya: also capture customer impact and estimated minutes of degraded SLO for AcmeCorp.
Riley: handoff to Asha for overnight monitoring. If any regression, page me immediately.
Asha: ack. monitoring dashboards show stable metrics for 30m. closing oncall shift notes.
incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved — mitigation applied and customer impact mitigated. Please file postmortem within 72h and tag incident P1-structout-kvchurn. :white_check_mark:
